references.title: Live notes
references.take: Faculty views AI-generated meeting notes appearing in real-time as speakers discuss, with automatic summaries.

references.title: Adding AI meeting notes
references.take: User adds AI-transcribed notes to a document; system shows a transcription play button with stop controls and evidence timestamps.

references.title: Chatting with AI (live notes)
references.take: During a meeting, AI assistant offers quick-action buttons ('Suggest follow-up questions', 'Catch me up') alongside an auto-writing indicator.

references.title: Transcribing a meeting
references.take: Live meeting video with transcription sidebar; user interacts with notes while recording continues.

references.title: Adding a marker
references.take: User adds a text marker label to a podcast transcript at current playback position; marker appears inline below.

references.title: Adding a marker
references.take: During live recording, 'Mark Clip' button creates a marker at current timestamp; confirmation shows '00:59 Clip created from marker'.

references.title: Bookmarking a transcript
references.take: User selects text in meeting transcript and bookmarks it; saves section with timestamp for later retrieval.

references.title: Saving a highlight
references.take: Complex recording session UI with start/end markers, highlight labels, emoji icons, and collection management for saving clips.

references.title: Adding a tag
references.take: User creates a new session tag via dialog; sidebar navigation shows tagged sessions with associated metadata and filter options.

references.title: Adding tags
references.take: Video project metadata form with Tags field; user enters multiple tags to categorize or annotate the recorded video.

references.title: Adding a tag
references.take: Loom editor allows adding custom tags to segment video; tags appear as collapsible markers in timeline for quick navigation.

references.title: Adding an evaluator agent
references.take: User configures an AI evaluator agent to grade outputs using batch queries; agent runs asynchronously with custom knowledge sources.

references.title: Creating scores
references.take: User creates custom scorer agents to evaluate submissions; shows editor UI with language selection, TypeScript code, and versioning.

references.title: Adding an evaluator (javascript)
references.take: Expert document summarizer with AI evaluators; user defines rules for grading content structure, key points, and actionable recommendations.

references.title: Scoring a speaker
references.take: During call playback, coach scores speaker against multi-part scorecard (Rapport Building, Qualification, etc.) with 1–5 scale per item.

references.title: Coaching
references.take: Coaching view summarizes meeting outcome and highlights areas for improvement; shown alongside playback and scoring opportunities.

references.title: Generating a scorecard
references.take: Grain AI generates a custom scorecard from call content; user adjusts items, then scores the recording against the generated criteria.

references.title: Adding a scorecard
references.take: Candidate scorecard for interview grading; user fills out open-ended feedback and rates on Strong Yes / Yes / No / Strong No scale.

references.title: Commenting to a transcript
references.take: Call review with moment markers and timestamped comment thread; user leaves feedback tied to specific discussion points.

references.title: Commenting on a video
references.take: Video playback with side panel; user hovers over timeline to add timestamped comments, then types and posts feedback to stream.

references.title: Adding a comment
references.take: Descript editor shows transcript with inline comment box at current cursor position; comment links to specific word and timestamp.

references.title: Commenting on a video
references.take: Meeting insights view with video playback and comment panel; user adds timestamped feedback, mentions, and emoji reactions to discussion.

references.title: Commenting a video (fullscreen view)
references.take: Video fullscreen with comment overlay; user adds comment at specific timestamp with modal dialog, then confirms post.

references.title: Commenting a video
references.take: Video workspace with new video comment input field; user leaves typed feedback tied to playback moment.
